body:
EPISODE PACKAGE
====

EPISODE TITLE: THE SWOLLEN SUGAR BAG
SUBJECT / TOPIC: INTEGRATED SCIENCE / Movement of Materials in and out of the cell
GRADE: Grade 8 JSS
AGE RATING: 10+ (student-safe)
DURATION: 8 minutes
VISUAL STYLE: naturalistic live-action look with clear prop inserts (or 2D/3D cartoon adaptation of the same blocking)

LEARNING TIE-IN: Explain why the tubing gains water using osmosis, not vague “soaking”

LOGLINE: A visking-tubing demo confuses a class until a market-soaking beans story links osmosis to water moving across a membrane.

WORLD & CAST
----
• Setting / era: INT. lab + brief EXT. home kitchen flashback
• TONNY: learner who loves cooking metaphors. Costume: lab apron over uniform.
• MS. WAMBUI: teacher guiding the demo. Costume: lab coat.
• CHEBET: skeptical classmate. Costume: uniform.

SCREENPLAY
----

SCENE 1 — EXT./INT. OPENING LOCATION — DAY
----
ACTION: TONNY enters the world of the story with a clear goal: Explain why the tubing gains water using osmosis, not vague “soaking”. Camera follows hands and faces, not a chalkboard.

TONNY
If I can just get this right today, everything else will fall into place.

MS. WAMBUI
Then stop guessing. Show me what you think is happening.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Wide establishing → medium two-shot. Ambient authentic location SFX. Soft hopeful underscore.

SCENE 2 — SAME / NEARBY — DAY
----
ACTION: Obstacle appears. Stakes rise. Props related to the science idea are handled as real objects, not lecture aids.

TONNY
It looks simple. Watch me do it the usual way.

CHEBET
If you are wrong, we lose time — and maybe more than time.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Close-ups on props and worried eyes. Tension riser.

TONNY
If we ignore the detail, we will repeat the same mistake under pressure.

MS. WAMBUI
Then name the detail out loud while you do the action — teaching by doing, not by speech notes.

SCENE 3 — CONFRONTATION — DAY
----
ACTION: WRONG WAY: Chebet says sugar particles push out to equalize everything like diffusion only. The problem worsens. Meaning stays in action and argument — characters never read notes aloud.

TONNY
See? I did what everyone does.

MS. WAMBUI
And it got worse. That means your idea about it is incomplete.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Handheld urgency. Cut to the failed result.

SCENE 4 — DISCOVERY — DAY/NIGHT
----
ACTION: A clue appears through action — a label, a measurement, a safer method, a remembered rule spoken as dialogue while doing.

MS. WAMBUI
Look at what actually changed. Name it properly.

TONNY
Wait… if that is true, then I was measuring the wrong thing.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Insert shots of evidence. Music shifts from tension to curiosity.

TONNY
If we ignore the detail, we will repeat the same mistake under pressure.

MS. WAMBUI
Then name the detail out loud while you do the action — teaching by doing, not by speech notes.

SCENE 5 — SECOND ATTEMPT — DAY
----
ACTION: RIGHT WAY: Tonny traces water movement across the selectively permeable membrane. Characters perform the corrected action step by step.

TONNY
This time we follow the rule, not the rumour.

CHEBET
I can see the difference already.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Cleaner framed shots; success micro-beats.

SCENE 6 — COMPLICATION — DAY
----
ACTION: A new obstacle or time pressure forces them to apply the idea again, proving it was not luck.

CHEBET
We are not done. Another problem just arrived.

MS. WAMBUI
Same science. Fresh situation. Go.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Parallel cut or ticking clock motif without graphic peril.

TONNY
If we ignore the detail, we will repeat the same mistake under pressure.

MS. WAMBUI
Then name the detail out loud while you do the action — teaching by doing, not by speech notes.

SCENE 7 — RESOLUTION — DAY
----
ACTION: Payoff: goal achieved. Characters show the result; still no voice-over lecture.

TONNY
It worked because we used the idea correctly — not because we pushed harder the same wrong way.

MS. WAMBUI
Say the reason in your own words before we pack up.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Warm wider shot; relieved faces; result hero insert.

SCENE 8 — BUTTON — DAY
----
ACTION: Final acted beat tying emotion to the learning without reading notes aloud.

CHEBET
Next time someone guesses, we will ask for the reason.

TONNY
And we will check the evidence first.

CAMERA / SFX / MUSIC: Slow push-in; music resolves.

TONNY
If we ignore the detail, we will repeat the same mistake under pressure.

MS. WAMBUI
Then name the detail out loud while you do the action — teaching by doing, not by speech notes.

BOOKENDS
----
• COLD OPEN (max 10s): Quick hook image of the failed first attempt — then cut to title THE SWOLLEN SUGAR BAG.
• CLOSING REFLECTION CARD (max 10s): On-screen question — What moves in osmosis, and through what? Answer must match lesson solutions (Water across a selectively permeable membrane).

CAPTIONS
----
TONNY: If I can just get this right today, everything else will fall into place.
MS. WAMBUI: Then stop guessing. Show me what you think is happening.
TONNY: It looks simple. Watch me do it the usual way.
CHEBET: If you are wrong, we lose time — and maybe more than time.
TONNY: See? I did what everyone does.
MS. WAMBUI: And it got worse. That means your idea about it is incomplete.
MS. WAMBUI: Look at what actually changed. Name it properly.
TONNY: Wait… if that is true, then I was measuring the wrong thing.
TONNY: This time we follow the rule, not the rumour.
CHEBET: I can see the difference already.
CHEBET: We are not done. Another problem just arrived.
MS. WAMBUI: Same science. Fresh situation. Go.
TONNY: It worked because we used the idea correctly — not because we pushed harder the same wrong way.
MS. WAMBUI: Say the reason in your own words before we pack up.
CHEBET: Next time someone guesses, we will ask for the reason.
TONNY: And we will check the evidence first.

ASSET LIST
----
• Characters: TONNY, MS. WAMBUI, CHEBET
• Costumes: as listed above
• Locations: INT. lab + brief EXT. home kitchen flashback
• Props: topic-authentic objects for Movement of Materials in and out of the cell
• Key shots: failed attempt insert, evidence insert, successful payoff insert

Study pages available for fidelity: 20
DRAMA NOTE: No voice-over of lesson notes. Meaning travels through action and in-character dialogue.
